title: Fleet Roster Uplift on Out-of-Area Repair Reimbursements
content:
A vehicle on a Crestline Fleet Account roster receives an uplift on the reimbursement of an out-of-area tire repair under Road Hazard Protection.

**Repair fleet uplift.** A vehicle whose latest roster enrollment entry has no later removal entry, on a Crestline Fleet Account in status active whose program carries the Crestline national fleet price file, adds 15 USD to the out-of-area repair reimbursement; such a vehicle on an active fleet account whose program has no national price file adds 10 USD; any other vehicle adds nothing.

The uplift is added to the out-of-area repair reimbursement.

| Open roster enrollment | Account active | National price file | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | 15.00 |
| yes | yes | no | 10.00 |
| yes | no | — | none |
| no | — | — | none |
